comment: The declarative routine patch contract shared by the bridge and Flow. TypeScript reads it directly and the Swift contract file is generated from it. Add or change a declarative rule here first.
stringBoundsComment: Text ceilings shared the same way, measured in UTF-16 code units on both sides because that is what JavaScript's length measures without being asked. The bridge derives its snapshot and patch schemas from these; FlowTests asserts the app's own constants against them, and the app enforces them at the point of typing so a name the editors accept is never one the snapshot upload refuses. proposedRoutineName is deliberately tighter than name: a routine name a coach proposes (createRoutine, renameRoutine) gets 100 where the snapshot carries up to 200.
